parks.intro: A family-run wild animal park in the woods west of the lake, on Ledgedale Road near Lake Ariel. Shaded trails lead past the animals, with a petting zoo, feeding stations and a dinosaur dig for children.

things.note: Visitors hand-feed the park's giraffe; feed is sold at the park.
A walk-in area where the lories land on you to feed, at set times.
Walk in to pet and hand-feed deer, sheep and goats.
Meet and feed the large tortoises at set times.
A dino dig, fossil hunts and a Triceratops to sit on, open all day.

parks.visit: The park's site lists a season from May 1 to mid-October, open daily 10 am to 6 pm with last admission at 5 pm. It is closed for the winter now. The snack bar is cash only. See the park's site for admission prices.
parks.fine: Paths, buildings and facilities come from OpenStreetMap. The animal list is from the park's own website, which says it keeps more than 120 species, so this is only part of it. The figures stand beside the paths for illustration: they do not show where each animal lives. An independent map, not affiliated with the park.
